title: Menu of Deficit Options
units: Deficit reduction in the last year of the estimate (+ = smaller deficit)
source: Congressional Budget Office; Joint Committee on Taxation; Social Security and Medicare Trustees; author's calculations.
note: Effect in the final year of each estimate, excluding debt service. The two Social Security rows and the memo lines are instead 75-year present values.

data.label: Revenue options
Levy a 10 percent value-added tax
Raise all individual income tax rates by 6 points
Raise the payroll tax rate by 4 points
Repeal the 2025 (OBBBA) tax cuts
A high-income package of five CBO options
Keep all the 2025 tariffs rather than the pre-2025 regime
Raise the corporate rate to 28% and tax foreign income in full
Spending options
Cut nondefense discretionary spending by 20 percent
Reduce Social Security benefits for the top half of earners
Raise the Social Security retirement age from 67 to 70
Cut all income-security (function 600) programs by 20 percent
Raise the Medicare Advantage coding adjustment to 20 percent
Cap Medicaid spending per enrollee at CPI plus 1 percent
Convert Medicare to premium support
Hold defense spending at its current share of GDP
Raise defense spending to 3.5 percent of GDP
